headline: Good News!, OJK Prepares Fund Refunds for Victims of Stock Manipulation
summary: Indonesia's financial services authority, OJK, is preparing to return funds to investors harmed by capital market violations. The money will be distributed through customer fund accounts.
why: OJK is Indonesia's financial services regulator, and its enforcement and investor-compensation actions shape confidence in the capital market.
original_headline: Kabar Baik!, OJK Siapkan Pengembalian Dana Korban Manipulasi Saham
